name: scholar-workflow
description: Plan-first scholarly resource management: scope research requests, manage papers through Zotero, maintain Obsidian and Notion projections, build literature trees, recommend papers, and write detailed analyses.

interface.shortDescription: Research workflows across Zotero, Obsidian, and Notion
interface.longDescription: Discover, verify, import, organize, and analyze scholarly resources with Zotero as the authoritative library and Obsidian or Notion as controlled projections.
defaultPrompt: Survey a research topic and build a literature map.
Find a paper, check my Zotero library, and import it safely.
Analyze a saved paper and update my research notes.
